description: Civic archive for the 19 wards of Municipal Council Jhajjar, northwest of Farrukhnagar and Manesar near the KMP Expressway and Reliance MET City corridor. Jhajjar was upgraded from a municipal committee to a municipal council on 7 August 2020.
